In short

Charity team building for conferences is a give-back built for the scale and format of a conference: a general-session, breakout or evening experience where 50 to 5,000 attendees build something real — bikes, care packages, skateboards or shoes — that is donated to children and communities in the host city, with the recipients onsite for the reveal. Legendary Team Building produced the 2017 Guinness World Record charity bike build for DaVita with 5,000 employees in one room, and brings give-backs to conference hotels nationwide. It’s charity & CSR team building made for the main stage, alongside your wider conference team building.

Built for the room

General session, breakout track or evening event. We scale the same give-back from a 50-person breakout to a 5,000-person general session, fit it to your run-of-show, and handle all materials, crew, setup and teardown in your ballroom. You bring the attendees; we bring the local charity to the host city.

How a conference give-back comes together

  1. Tell us the city, dates and headcount. We confirm we can scale to your general session or breakouts.
  2. Choose the cause. We source and vet a local charity in the host city, such as a Boys & Girls Club.
  3. We fit it to your run-of-show — general session, breakout track or evening event.
  4. Your attendees build, and the recipients arrive onsite for the reveal.
  5. You get the impact numbers for CSR and ESG, plus a story for sponsors and press.
The proof

5,000 people. One room. One world record.

In 2017 we produced the Guinness World Record charity bike build for DaVita — 5,000 employees building 979 bikes for 1,000 kids in a single general session. It’s the clearest proof a give-back can be the centerpiece of even the largest conference. See the DaVita case study.

Questions, answered

Conference charity team building FAQs

What is a good charity team building activity for a conference? +

A give-back built for scale: a charity bike build (Building a Dream), a care-package build (Operation You Matter) or a shoe build (Sole Purpose), run as a general session or breakouts for 50 to 5,000 attendees, with a local charity in the host city receiving the donation onsite. Legendary Team Building produced the Guinness World Record charity bike build for 5,000 people.

Can you run a charity team building activity in our conference city? +

Yes — we bring conference give-backs to host cities nationwide, including Las Vegas, Orlando, Nashville, Phoenix / Scottsdale, Atlanta, Denver, Chicago, Dallas, San Diego, Seattle, Austin and Miami / Fort Lauderdale. We source and vet the local charity in your host city and bring all materials and crew to your venue.

How many conference attendees can do a give-back at once? +

From 50 in a breakout to 5,000 in a general session. Legendary Team Building holds the Guinness World Record for the largest charity bike build, set with 5,000 employees in a single room.

Can a give-back run as a conference general session? +

Yes — it is the ideal general-session format: one shared moment, a big reveal, and a story for sponsors and press. It also runs as a breakout track or an evening event, and fits your run-of-show.

Who receives the donation at a conference give-back? +

A vetted local charity in the host city, chosen with you — often with the children onsite to receive what attendees built. Boys & Girls Clubs are Legendary Team Building’s #1 recipient partner.

How much does conference charity team building cost? +

$50 to $225 per person depending on the program, including materials, the donation and bringing the recipients onsite. Groups over 1,000 are custom-priced. See what corporate team building costs.

How far ahead should we book for a conference? +

Four to twelve weeks is ideal; large general sessions, peak conference season and November and December dates go sooner. Tell us your city and dates and we’ll hold it.
